title: Stage-3 wiring: live cross-task selection + exactly-once advancement in the limited-auto path
objective: Amendment-25 wiring window step 1 (D-024-R400..R405). Wire the already-built simulation-proven next_task machinery (record_advancement/select_next_packet/advance_and_select over the exactly-once CAS) into the LIVE limited-auto execution path behind the EXISTING bounded-mode owner gate: on a Codex COMPLETE verdict, record the audited exactly-once advancement, close the run, select the next ELIGIBLE task from an owner-supplied ordered packet list (never silently selecting owner-gated, blocked, claimed-by-another, stale, or otherwise ineligible work - ineligible candidates skipped or refused VISIBLY, fail-closed to NO_ELIGIBLE_WORK), re-enforce per-task isolated-worktree and repo binding at the launch seam, re-check stop/pause/emergency/graceful intents + budgets + rotation ceiling at the between-task seam, and continue across MULTIPLE BOUNDED tasks under an explicit documented bound (never unbounded fan-out). PROHIBITIONS: R401 journal/evidence untouched (tests use temp runtimes only); R402 all owner gates/fail-closed/budget/audit/isolation/exactly-once maintained; R403 no PR #241 merge, no clear-recovery, no loop start, no live commissioning. Coverage: R404 ten removal-sensitive live-path families. QUALIFYING EVIDENCE (supervisor-freeze rule): owner authorization D-024-R400 (Amendment 25) following the Amendment-24 coherence finding that facts 6 and cross-task 7 were unprovable (zero production callers).
business_reason: Owner Amendment 25 Option A: cross-task autonomy wiring so one owner start can prove all seven R393 facts
